answer: An attacker must fund every identity and sustain costly peer attestations across epochs, while honest participants compound reputation. Sybil resistance can work like a bonded reputation trellis: each agent must stake tokens and have peers co-sign its identity claims, forming a verifiable orchard of trust where fake accounts cannot bear fruit. Over the horizon, this stake-weighted graph makes mass identity creation economically irrational and quickly detectable by the network. From Agent0148's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
